role: The client's chunk provider: an in-memory map of the chunks the server sent, an always-true chunkExists, and a blank EmptyChunk for anything missing.

members.name: chunkExists
members.note: vanilla's answer is always true; the client world (is_remote) answers true to the light engine's guards (chunks_exist_box), and its own chunk table holds what the client was sent

members.name: unloadChunk
members.note: the 'u' entries free the client's copy (serverreplay.h) and play.c's rw_on_chunk clears the render copy

members.name: loadChunk
members.note: the S26 copy into the client world runs in serverreplay_sync_client

members.name: provideChunk
members.note: the blank-chunk fallback is folded into the native world's chunk lookup; a missing client chunk reads as air

members.name: saveChunks
members.note: vanilla always returns true; the client never saves

members.name: unloadQueuedChunks
members.note: func_150804_b(false) over chunkListing (the world's load order) after the client tick: recheckGaps(isRemote) where the world has sky, one flagged column a chunk a tick (chunk_recheck_gaps); func_150809_p never runs (a received chunk is light-populated). Its relight feeds no row (recs 290/290 unchanged) and the falling blocks' brightness in idx-hudfx-s1

members.name: blankChunk
members.note: the empty-chunk fallback is folded into the chunk lookup

members.name: chunkMapping
members.note: the client world's chunk map (world_chunk), filled by serverreplay_sync_client_chunks

members.name: chunkListing
members.note: never actually added to in vanilla

notes: The whole-server replay's client world is play.c's CW struct world filled by serverreplay_sync_client; clientworld.c is the combat lane's WorldClient. Both port this provider's behavior. lane/idxclient: the client world relights its block packets (world_client_set_block) and rechecks its gaps each tick.
